title: Create proper printable invoice layout (not a screen print)

requirements.text: Implement a dedicated, print-optimized invoice document layout that prints as a clean invoice (not a copy of the on-screen invoice detail UI). The printed output must exclude all app navigation/actions and exclude photo sections and edit/payment UI, while including core invoice information (logo, invoice number, paid/unpaid status, customer details, business address, line items, totals, and payment instructions).

quotes: I need the app to be able to print a proper invoice, not a copy of the screen

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Print from the invoice detail page prints a document-style invoice layout (not cards/buttons/tabs from the app UI).
The printed output does not include the top action bar (Back/Print/Download/Edit) and does not include Before/After photo sections.

The printed output includes: business logo, invoice number, paid/unpaid status, customer name and contact info (when available), BUSINESS_ADDRESS (and TEXT_NUMBER when non-empty), line item table, total amount due, amount paid, balance, and PAYMENT_INSTRUCTIONS.
The printed output is legible in black-and-white printing and does not depend on the app’s on-screen grid/card layout to look correct.

requirements.text: Change the current Print and Download PDF actions on the invoice detail page to use the dedicated invoice document layout for printing/downloading, rather than relying on printing the current screen view. If a separate print route or print-only view is used, it must render only the invoice document content and then trigger the browser print dialog.

quotes: print a proper invoice, not a copy of the screen

acceptanceCriteria: Print uses the dedicated invoice document layout.
Download PDF uses the same dedicated invoice document layout and results in a browser print dialog suitable for saving as PDF.
No additional backend calls are required beyond the existing invoice/customer queries already used for the invoice detail page.

requirements.text: Update/extend print CSS so the invoice document layout prints with consistent page sizing/margins and avoids awkward page breaks in tables/sections, while keeping the regular (non-print) invoice detail page unchanged for on-screen use.
acceptanceCriteria: Printed invoice uses consistent page margins and a standard page size already used by the app’s print rules (e.g., letter).
Line items table does not break mid-row; major sections avoid splitting across pages when feasible.
Non-print (screen) layout remains functional and visually unchanged aside from Print/Download behavior improvements.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
nonGoals: Generating PDFs server-side or adding a PDF generation library/service.
Emailing invoices or adding external integrations for document delivery.
Changing invoice data fields or backend invoice schema unless strictly necessary for printing (not requested).

preferencesToAdd: Use English for any user-facing text
